name: acc-0018
description: Acceptance 0018: the shipped binary never uses a tampered downloads tree: an extracted tree that differs from its build record (a file, or a file and its sidecar) is replaced from the embedded blob, a binary whose embedded record names another tree refuses to start.

actions.label: Run 0018
actions.description: Tamper the extracted socialweb-guest-downloads tree (file only, file and sidecar) and run `dev verify-assets` again: healed, served bytes equal the recorded ones; flip one digit of the embedded record in a copy of the binary: it refuses.
